verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇੜੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਲੰਘਾਇਦਾ ਬਾਹਲੇ ਪੂਰ ਮਾਣਸ ਮੋਹਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: beRee chaaR la(n)ghaidhaa baahale poor maanas mohaanaa|

en.bdb: Only one person ferries across many a man.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਗੂ ਇਕੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਦਾ ਲਸਕਰ ਸੰਗ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: aagoo ik nibaahidhaa lasakar sa(n)g saeh sulataanaa|

en.bdb: The one commander of the imperial army gets the whole task executed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰੈ ਮਹਲੈ ਪਾਹਰੂ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ਸਵਨਿ ਪਰਧਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: firai mahalai paaharoo hoi nichi(n)dh savan paradhaanaa|

en.bdb: Because of only one watchman in the locality, all the rich persons sleep free from any anxiety.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਾੜਾ ਇਕੁ ਵਿਵਾਹੀਐ ਬਾਹਲੇ ਜਾਞੀਂ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਹਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: laaRaa ik vivaaheeaai baahale jaan(j)ee(n) kar mihamaanaa|

en.bdb: Guests in the marriage party remain many but the marriage is solemnized of one person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਮੁਲਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: paatisaahu ik mulak vich hor prajaa hi(n)dhoo musalamaanaa|

en.bdb: The emperor in the country happens to be one and the rest are the public in the forms of Hindus and Muslims.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatisaahu saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh neesaanaa|

en.bdb: Similarly the true Guru Emperor is one and the holy congregation and the Guru word-shabad  are His identification marks.
I sacrifice myself unto them who seek the shelter of the true Guru.
